# Generator-shortcuts answer

**Question.** For this generator, name the strongest plausible shortcut or rival
rule that fits the canonical demonstrations. Give an exact input on which it
disagrees with the intended rule, how you checked the output, and whether your
proposed generator emits such cases.

**Strongest rival:** `single_seed_8_chambers` — fill a zero component only when it
is enclosed, touches color-8 walls, and has exactly one colored neighboring cell.
This is stronger and more plausible than identity because it explains the visible
transformations in all five usable canonical pairs. The canonical demonstrations
all use precisely that one-seed, 8-walled chamber idiom, so the rival fits every
canonical input/output pair.

**Exact disagreement.** Use generator SHA
`570fc941da7e0efc5efbee58d5b49f8173a062b6c2966201d8bf7c02a92dcc73`
with seed `901`, sample index `1`, difficulty `hard`, and exact override
`profile="composite_open_left"`. The complete input and both predictions are in
`repo/generators/60a8a9d74a75/counterexamples/single_seed_8_chambers.json` and
`checks/shortcut-witness-probe.json`. The grid is 21×25 and has four zero regions:
repeated same-color seeds, mixed colors, an edge-connected single-color region, and
a region bounded directly by a non-8 color. The intended rule changes 151 cells;
the shortcut changes none, so the differing output is unambiguous.

**How checked.** `workspace/reference_probe.py` independently recomputed every
4-connected zero component and its distinct cardinal neighbor colors. Its intended
output was then passed through the supported Racket command; the receipt in
`checks/shortcut-witness/racket.json` records executed rule hash `49411595dc9e`,
and the Racket output equals the independent reference. The focused test
`test_retained_shortcut_counterexample_refutes_single_seed_chambers` reloads the
stored input and both outputs.

**Does the proposed generator emit it?** Yes. It emits a composite profile at
sample-index residues 1 and 3 modulo 4, so two of every four ordinary scheduled
pairs refute this shortcut. The exact retained case is generated directly rather
than hand-injected. Across the independent 400-draw scan, the shortcut disagreed on
200/400 inputs; across the 300-lesson census, every production lesson and all 1,200
query rotations refuted every declared rival.
